extracted.intended_audience: UW–Madison researchers, principal investigators, department research administrators, and staff who prepare and manage sponsored projects
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional guidance and resources for finding funding, preparing proposals, negotiating agreements, setting up awards, managing awards, and closing out sponsored projects at the University of Wisconsin–Madison.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding Funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Find internal/external resources and links to funding opportunities for supporting your research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Finding Funding resources and links provided by RSP to identify appropriate funding mechanisms and opportunities to support research programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal Preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Software, tools, and information on getting your proposal routed and submitted correctly and on time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow institutional proposal-preparation procedures and use specified electronic tools (e.g., Cayuse, WISER) to ensure correct routing, completeness, compliance, and timely submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement Negotiation
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on the agreement negotiation process for sponsored awards and contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage RSP for negotiation of sponsor terms and conditions; follow RSP guidance and workflows to ensure agreements meet university policy and sponsor requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Setup
rubrics_metrics.description: Once an award is accepted, guidance to get the award set up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete required setup steps through RSP so that accounts, reporting, and administrative structures are established to begin project activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Management
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitoring of expenditures, invoicing, and financial reporting, processing sponsor payments, modification of existing awards, and subawards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage awards in accordance with sponsor terms and university policy: monitor expenditures, submit invoices and reports, process sponsor payments, request and process award modifications, and manage outgoing/ incoming subawards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Closeout
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensures all appropriate expenditures have been applied and results in the closing of the account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow closeout procedures to confirm expenditures, finalize financial and technical reporting, reconcile accounts, and close the award according to sponsor and university requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Routing Guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how to process various sponsored project items via RSP routing tools and search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the routing guidance tool/search field to locate topic-specific instructions for processing sponsored project items; select from populated results for item-specific workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: RSP Mission and Service Values
rubrics_metrics.description: RSP advances the university's research mission by providing timely, professional, and people-centered support—ensuring strong stewardship, regulatory compliance, and practical solutions that reduce administrative burden and improve the research experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RSP's service is guided by values: Excellence in Service; Integrity & Compliance; Collaboration & Partnership; Innovation & Continuous Improvement; People-Centered Approach; Transparency & Accountability. These values inform expectations for support quality and conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Electronic Tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated electronic systems to support proposal routing, effort reporting, cost transfers, subawards, and financial tracking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RSP lists tools such as ECRT, WISPER, Cayuse, WISER, Cost Transfer Tool, Current/Pending Support Tool, Subaward Portal, and PI Financials Tool—use the appropriate tool for the related administrative function to remain compliant and efficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational Identifiers and Rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative identifiers and negotiated rates to be used in proposals and awards (e.g., Tax ID, SAM UEI, DUNS, Cage/NCAGE Code, congressional district, cognizant federal agency, F&A rate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include correct institutional metadata and current F&A rate (55.5% until 6/30/2026 as listed) in proposals and budget calculations; verify identifiers and rates before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: No-Cost Extension Procedures (linked resource)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for requesting a no-cost extension for sponsored awards (listed under 'No-Cost Extension Request Procedures').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the university's documented procedures for requesting and approving no-cost extensions to ensure compliance with sponsor rules and institutional policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy-Specific Guidance (examples listed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Links and references to policy-specific guidance and resources such as Cost Sharing, Cost Transfer Policy, Effort Reporting, DHHS Salary Cap Guidance, Uniform Guidance, and Extramural Support Policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the relevant policy pages (cost sharing, cost transfers, effort commitments, salary cap limits, uniform guidance) and adhere to their requirements when preparing proposals and managing awards to ensure compliance.
